name: autopilot
description: Plan and implement tasks autonomously: interactive planning with the user, a plan explanation, then a supervised implementation run with automatic restarts and live status, plus guided setup of the plan runner and model router.

optionalDependencies.name: code-explainer
optionalDependencies.reason: The autopilot skill uses explain-summarize to present the finished plan before asking whether to implement it, and summarize to describe the finished work in the final report.
